entry.title: Osirus 0.2.10
entry.summary: **Lower CPU on Gen2 (MPC Live III).** The emulator now runs on the Live III's fast cores (Cortex-A76) instead of drifting onto the slow ones (Cortex-A55), with the DSP and emulator threads each on a core of their own. Measured on a Live III with 8 voices held: about 29% of a core, was 40-57%. Nothing else changed. No ROMs included, as before.

entry.title: Osirus 0.2.9
entry.summary: **Osirus for MPC 0.2.9**: no more crackle on heavy chords, favourites in MPC's PRESET menu, and `.syx` banks. - **Headroom.** Heavy, high-velocity chords made the emulated Virus clip its own output (the crackle some of you heard, with DROPOUTS at 0). Osirus now keeps the Virus's channel volume at about 100 and gives the difference back after it, with a soft limiter, so ordinary patches sound as loud as before and hot ones no longer clip. There is no new control; OUTPUT LEVEL % is unchanged. PATC

entry.title: Osirus 0.2.8
entry.summary: **Osirus for MPC 0.2.8**: an external MIDI keyboard now plays, and the GAIN knob is renamed. - A keyboard (or any controller) on a MIDI channel other than 1 was silent while the pads played. Osirus now accepts every channel on the track. - DSP CLOCK % stays at a 100 maximum (100 is the real instrument's speed). - GAIN % is now OUTPUT LEVEL %: it is the plugin's volume on the track, applied after the emulated Virus. entry.title: Osirus 0.2.3
entry.summary: First release of **Osirus for MPC**: an emulation of the Access Virus A, B and C (gearmulator's DSP56300 emulator running the original firmware) as a native VST2 instrument for **Gen2 MPC devices** (MPC Live III and kin, aarch64, MPC OS 3.x). Gen1 devices and the Force are not supported. - 11 touchscreen pages in the Galaxpel skin look (PLAY, BANKS, OSC, FILTER, ENV, LFO 1+2, LFO 3 / ARP, MOD, FX 1, FX 2, VELOCITY), knob values on every knob, Q-Link groups outlined by MPC, bank and patch browser
